chapters.summary: Through Malachi, God declares his love for Israel, rebukes the priests for despising his name and offering defiled sacrifices, and foretells that the nations will honor his name.
keyPoints: God reaffirms his love for Israel, showing that he chose Jacob rather than Esau.
The priests despise God's name, offering blind and lame animals as sacrifices and defiling the temple.
All nations will offer pure offerings, and God's name will be great among the Gentiles.
chapters.application: Let us reflect on our attitude in worship - are we offering God our very best? Let us serve him with reverence and sincerity, so that his name may be glorified in our lives.

chapters.summary: Malachi chapter 2 rebukes the priests for neglecting their duties and the people for breaking covenant, declares God's judgment on the unfaithful, and calls people to be faithful to their marriage covenant.
keyPoints: The priests despise God's name and turn aside from the right way, causing many to stumble, so God will curse their blessings.
The people deal treacherously with their brothers and break the covenant God made with their fathers, and God hates divorce and violence.
God calls people to guard their hearts, to remain faithful to the wife of their youth, and not to deal treacherously.
chapters.application: Today, let us remain faithful to God in our work and our families, dealing honestly with others and honoring marriage, so that God's name may be glorified.

chapters.summary: The LORD promises to send a messenger to prepare the way, and to come himself to bring judgment and refining; he calls the people to return to him and promises to bless those who fear him.
keyPoints: The LORD of hosts sends his messenger to prepare the way, and the Lord will suddenly come to his temple.
God, like a refiner's fire, burns away impurity and purifies the sons of Levi, so that their offerings may be pleasing to him.
God calls the people to return to him, promising to open the windows of heaven and pour out blessing beyond what they can contain.
chapters.application: God promises to bless those who give faithfully. Let us respond in faith, bringing the full tithe, and experience his abundant grace and provision.

chapters.summary: The day of the LORD draws near - the wicked will be burned up, those who fear God will find healing and victory, and the prophet Elijah will bring reconciliation within families.
keyPoints: The great and dreadful day of the LORD is near, and the wicked will be burned up like stubble.
Those who fear God's name will have the sun of righteousness rise upon them, and they will leap for joy like calves released from the stall.
God will send Elijah to turn the hearts of fathers to their children, so that the land will not be struck with a curse.
chapters.application: As we wait for the day of the Lord, let us fear God, hold fast to our faith, and take the initiative to reconcile with our families, so that we may be ready to meet him.
